list.name: core
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT core FROM uta.axf_metrics WHERE product='$product'

list.name: key
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT key FROM uta.axf_metrics WHERE product='$product' AND core='$core'

panels.title: Curated metric vs elapsed time (run overlay at t=0)

targets.rawSql: SELECT elapsed_s AS time, trname, value_num FROM uta.axf_metrics WHERE product='$product' AND core='$core' AND key='$key' ORDER BY elapsed_s
SELECT error_type, count() AS n FROM uta.axf_decode_errors WHERE occurred_at > now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY error_type ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT toStartOfHour(ingested_at) AS time, count() AS snapshots FROM uta.axf_snapshots GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
